items.subtext: Xeuqra Records is an independent label for experimental electronic music. We release records that sit somewhere between IDM, ambient and noise, with a focus on strange textures, unfinished-sounding structures and sounds that don’t ask permission. Every release comes with its own visual world.

Xeuqra Design is the visual studio behind the label. We make cover art, identities, merch and 90s-style CGI animations, recorded to tape and left dirty on purpose. The same hands that design the label’s world are open to work with other artists and projects.

items.text: Audio, Software Instruments and VST plugins
items.subtext: Xeuqra Audio builds plugins and software instruments for producers. Tools with character: sounds and interfaces designed to inspire rather than to behave. Made by people who make music, for people who make music

Xeuqra Sandbox is where music turns into space. We build addons for Garry’s Mod: DJ setups, a cassette deck, a turntable that plays both vinyl and tape and lets you export your own music into the game, and speakers with 3D sound on the Source engine. Playable instruments, listenable rooms.
Do you have any questions or would you like to get in touch with us? Please email us at: contact@xeuqra.com
